_doc: Safety envelope enforced by the guard. min/max: absolute limits. max_step: largest change in one command. max_change_per_min: largest net change within any 60 s window (stops slow-ramp attacks). prediction: the digital twin simulates horizon_min ahead and blocks commands that would push the water outside these bands. Edit via the dashboard (engineer PIN) or here.

chlorine_dose.reason: dose cap; the residual itself (EPA max 4.0 mg/L) is checked by the twin

naoh_dose.reason: lye overdose pushes pH above the EPA 6.5-8.5 range

distribution_rate.reason: sudden flow changes cause pressure surges (water hammer)

distribution_pump.reason: stopping it cuts water to the town

interlocks.message: can't stop distribution while clearwell is above 90% (overflow risk)
can't stop intake while clearwell is below 15% (town runs dry)
